scope: Read-only discovery and endpoint probes; no application, source_health or queue changes; no WAF challenge solving, no proxy/TLS bypass, no form submission.

limitations.codex_runtime: Runner transport result to be recorded separately; environment restriction alone cannot establish EXTERNAL_BLOCKER for the source.
limitations.webtool: Search text and web opens can be cached/indexed. Crawl labels are retained and none are represented as origin wire capture. 'Not accessible via this tool' does not prove endpoint absence.
limitations.dates: 51 initial in-horizon article details have exact publisher publication dates and verified identity/body;2 material candidates after common gate review.14 actual archive continuations repeat initial state, so90-day coverage remains incomplete. Data periods, signing/approval and modification dates stay excluded.
limitations.rss_api: Fresh /feed/ redirects to portal HTML, not RSS. Fresh sitemap is static official institutional route listing, not a dated article inventory. No declared public API verified.
limitations.memoria_2025: Superseded by live official Memorias listing Run6: exact2025 attachment observed; PDF capture and explicit publication day pending. Prior search absence never proved publisher absence.

actions_recommendation: GET prioritized exact official URLs on isolated GitHub Actions runner using TLS verification and ordinary bot/browser User-Agents. Respect robots restrictions. Persist status, redirects, final URL, content type, content SHA256 and WAF markers; require real HTML/article date or valid PDF bytes. Compare with Codex environment before any source-level blocker conclusion.
